blocks.text: The Zscaler Help Browser is available for all pages within the Business Insights Admin Portal. Through the Help Browser you can view Zscaler Help Portal articles in context with the page you're on, without leaving the Business Insights Admin Portal.

blocks.item: Go to the page where you want to view an article.
Click the Open Help Browser icon in the lower-right corner.

blocks.text: The Help Browser displays the article and any video relevant to the page you're viewing
The Help Browser is also adjustable. There are different features to help you customize the browser and navigate within it.
You can do the following to customize the Help Browser:

blocks.item: You can move the Help Browser anywhere within the menu bar and footer. When you hover over the browser header, a Move cursor appears. Click and drag the Help Browser to the desired location.

You can resize the Help Browser to expand videos, pictures, and content. When you hover to the top-left corner of the browser, an Expand cursor appears. Click and drag the corner to resize the window.
There are different font sizes for the Help Browser. You can click the Font icons to increase or decrease the text size.

blocks.text: Zscaler saves your customization until you log out or the session expires.
You can do the following to navigate within the Help Browser:

blocks.item: View the article relevant to the page you're viewing in the Business Insights Admin Portal.
Navigate back and forth across articles you've viewed.
Copy the URL of an article.
Open the article in new browser tab.

blocks.text: Closing the Help Browser clears your navigation history. When you reopen the browser, it displays the article relevant to the page you are viewing, and you are unable to navigate back and forth to articles you've viewed in the previous Help Browser session.
